title: Thai Re-Entry Permit: Keep Your Extension When You Travel
summary: If you are in Thailand on an extension of stay (retirement, marriage, work or study), leaving the country cancels it unless you get a re-entry permit first. A single permit costs 1,000 THB and a multiple permit 3,800 THB.
seoTitle: Thailand Re-Entry Permit: Single 1,000 THB, Multiple 3,800 THB
seoDescription: Why you need a re-entry permit before leaving Thailand on an extension, how to get one at immigration or the airport, the fees and the form (TM8).

sections.heading: What a re-entry permit does
paragraphs: Your permission to stay in Thailand normally ends when you leave. A re-entry permit keeps it alive, so when you come back you get the same permission-to-stay date as before.
Without one, a 1-year extension ends at departure and you have to start again with a new visa.

sections.heading: Who needs one
list: Anyone on a 1-year extension, such as retirement, marriage, work or study.
Holders of a single-entry visa who want to leave and come back within their permitted stay.
You don't need one if your visa already allows multiple entries and you haven't extended your stay. Ask immigration if you're unsure.

sections.heading: Fees
list: Single re-entry permit: 1,000 THB (one trip out and back).
Multiple re-entry permit: 3,800 THB (as many trips as you like until your permission to stay ends).

sections.heading: How to apply
list: Bring your passport, a copy of the photo page, visa or extension and latest entry stamp, and a 4x6 cm photo.
Apply at your local immigration office before you travel, or at a re-entry counter at some international airports before departure passport control.
Pay the fee and check the stamp in your passport before you leave the counter.

sections.heading: Things to know
paragraphs: The permit can't outlast your permission to stay. You must come back before your extension expires.
The return date you write on the form is not binding. You can come back on a different day, as long as it is before your permission to stay ends.
When you return, your 90-day count starts again at day 1. Remember the TDAC and a new TM30.

faqs.q: Can I get a re-entry permit at the airport?
faqs.a: Some international airports have a counter before departure passport control, but queues can be long. Getting it at your immigration office in advance is safer.
If you'll travel more than twice before your extension ends, the multiple permit (3,800 THB) usually works out cheaper than several single ones (1,000 THB each).

faqs.q: I forgot to get one. What now?
faqs.a: Your extension ended when you left. You need a new visa to come back, then you start the extension process again.

faqs.q: Does a re-entry permit extend my stay?
faqs.a: No. It only keeps your existing permission to stay. It never adds time.
